_ghi_chu: Chi con thu cua RIENG cai may nay. Moi num van (gio quet, giu Chrome...) chinh tren TOOL: tab Phan tich & Nghien cuu > May VM.
_ghi_chu_nhieu_kenh: 1 VPS toi da 10 kenh CUNG NICHE (tran nang tu 5 len 10 sau Dot 1-2, xem workspace/LO-TRINH-PHAT-HANH-V3.md): dien 'cac_kenh' la danh sach ma, moi kenh mot trinh duyet <MA>\<MA>.exe nam CANH NHAU (vd C:\Users\...\TL\TL4-T7\, C:\Users\...\TL\KENH2\...). Bo trong ('cac_kenh': []) thi agent tu doan theo cac thu muc canh ben; may CHI MOT kenh thi dung 'kenh' nhu truoc, khong can dong 'cac_kenh'.
_ghi_chu_che_do_phien: che_do_phien=true + tram=http://127.0.0.1:8765 la cai dat CHUAN cua may VPS (vm/cai_dat_tu_kho.py ghi dung hai gia tri nay khi tao vm/config.json tu mau nay). Doi lai thi agent khong biet hoi tram, khong ai xep lich phien kenh.
